current.text: He re-signed with the Clippers. He has no starting spot.
The latest Clippers preview projects him as the tenth man, behind Kris Dunn, Bradley Beal, Brook Lopez and Keaton Wagler on the bench.
His minutes are uncertain because Beal re-signed. He needs big minutes and a couple of usage players out of the way to matter for fantasy.
The expert in the latest Clippers preview is not interested in him for fantasy.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a hip injury.

The Clippers have many injuries (Ingram, Beal, Jordan Miller and Konan Niederhauser are out), and the expert leans toward a trial season with long rotations and many players tested. Coach Ty Lue often changes his rotation choices.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule (4-3-4 games for a March 28 end) and one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: When he started as a rookie, he gave nothing for fantasy.
He is a low-volume role player. He has no strong category, and his points, rebounds and blocks are well below the top 250 pool.
